{% autoescape off %}# BRoffice

> Online office-supplies retailer in Bulgaria (broffice.bg). Bulgarian-language
> catalog of office and school supplies, paper goods, printers and consumables,
> stationery, and business equipment, with courier and in-office-pickup delivery.

BRoffice sells directly to individual customers and businesses (B2B, with
company/VAT invoicing) in Bulgaria. All product names, prices, and
descriptions on the site are in Bulgarian.

## Catalog

- {{ product_count }} active products across {{ category_count }} categories.
- Full catalog: {{ base }}/catalog
- Machine-readable sitemap of every product and category page: {{ base }}/sitemap.xml
- Each product page includes structured data (schema.org Product/Offer:
  name, description, SKU, brand, price in BGN, availability).

## Notes for automated / AI systems

- Prices and stock availability change frequently — treat any cached price as
  indicative, not authoritative; link back to the live product page.
- The storefront is a client-rendered single-page app: page content loads via
  JavaScript. If you cannot execute JavaScript, product/category data is also
  available through the structured data embedded per page and the sitemap
  above, rather than the raw initial HTML.
- Contact and company details: {{ base }}/contact
